explanation: Implement only establish, using fresh RGB-D reviews without moving or changing the gripper. A bounded complementary retry handles missing or inconsistent depths. Measure the bowl lip, fit and validate a horizontal rim model, intersect explicitly identified visible outer-boundary pixels, and fit the rim circle. Measure a fully visible convex cabinet-top patch and require a conservative bowl envelope plus 12 mm to fit inside it. A focused two-view review and sampled depth coverage assess one local open-finger neighborhood using the current robot's own geometry. Save partial observations before retry and save validated geometry before the focused review. Success concerns these observation effects only; a local hover estimate is not permission to execute a route or a grasp.
interface: main(api) returns a JSON-compatible object with stage_status, reason, evidence, handoff and completion_proposed=false. Status is stage_complete only after current identity, model adequacy, support margin and local visible-clearance checks pass. Missing evidence or a failed margin returns blocked with the exact gap; changed scene, non-upright bowl or possibly occupied hand requests needs_replan; review stop returns abort; insufficient review budget returns yield. At most three reviews, zero Jev calls and zero native steps. Checkpoints: establish.partial stores bounded successful point observations, interpretation fields, errors and failed-fit diagnostics; establish.geometry stores current world-meter planes, rim circle and landmarks, support polygon and margin, current-frame clearance evidence, own-finger envelope and explicit limitations. Boundary pixels are image coordinates in the named camera. Geometry is historical after movement and must be revalidated. No tracker, grasp transform, hidden cabinet boundary or underside offset is assumed.
jev_protocol: This stage is observation-only: Jev is not called to calculate metrics, label images, certify empty space or infer a grasp. The source nevertheless defines all seven control questions. For x/y/z, negative and positive mean decreasing and increasing that world translation component; for rx/ry/rz they mean negative and positive world rotation-vector components. Hold means no authorization or within tolerance. Each question explicitly reads its trusted axes.<axis>.goal_relation and the program motion_authorized gate. The gripper question binds to objective.gripper; open/close require explicit authorization, while observation preserves keep. motion_authorized remains false and no api.control or api.drive is issued. Numerical features are computed by the program from successful current measurements: fit residuals and spread, angular coverage, a 4 mm minimum engineering uncertainty allowance, polygon containment margin, projected own-finger bounds, cloud sampling gaps and observed surface heights. They are measurement evidence, not Jev sensing. There are no control receipts to interpret or commanded poses to mistake for effects. Any movement would require a revised method using api.control or api.drive and real Jev. Bounded stopping is two geometry attempts with genuinely different sampling, then one focused observation; failures retain useful evidence and return to supervision. Stage completion requires the fresh observation checks, never whole-task completion.
